entities.name: Microsoft Web Platform Installer
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary:
Web Platform Installer is a discontinued freeware, closed-source package management system developed by Microsoft that installs non-commercial development tools and their dependencies that are part of Microsoft Web Platform, including:Internet Information Services
WebMatrix
Visual Web Developer Express Edition
Microsoft SQL Server Express Edition
.NET Framework
Silverlight Tools for Visual Studio
PHP
WordPress
Umbraco
Drupal
Joomla! Orchard
